website_summary.name: Gangsta SDK Developer Portal
website_summary.description: The website is sleek and modern, featuring vibrant colors and smooth animations that enhance the user experience while guiding developers through integrating AI video generation into iOS applications.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a clean and professional design with a prominent header containing navigation links such as "Introduction," "Getting Started," "Code Sample," and "Showcase." The main content area includes sections like "AI-Powered Video Generation for iOS," which highlights the service's purpose. There are interactive buttons like "Get Started" and "See Examples," along with visually appealing cards describing features such as "Easy Integration," "Realistic AI," and "Customizable." The footer contains social media links and documentation access. Animations like hover effects and transitions between sections add a dynamic feel, while the use of gradients and shadows creates depth.
website_summary.functionality: The website offers several functionalities aimed at iOS developers. It provides an introduction to the Gangsta SDK, including its benefits and key features. Developers can get started by signing up for an API key and installing the SDK via Swift Package Manager. Code samples demonstrate integration within iOS projects, and a showcase section displays real-world examples of generated videos. The site also includes a dark mode toggle for user preference adjustments.
